caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair is shown in a three-quarter view facing towards the left side of the image. It features a dark brown, polished wooden frame with a high, narrow backrest that has a decorative cut-out splat in the center. The seat of the chair is made of a woven material, colored in light beige and arranged in a diagonal pattern. The legs of the chair are turned and also dark brown, with horizontal stretchers connecting them for support. There is an artist’s signature, “F. Alvarez,” located in the lower left corner of the drawing, just inside the border of a faint, hand-drawn rectangular frame that encloses the chair. The drawing is detailed and realistic in its depiction of the wood grain and woven seat texture.
title: Side Chair (one of a pair)
